selected_experiment.question: For fresh app nodes constructed inside substitute, is one child identity highly reusable while the other varies, or are both child positions diffuse?
selected_experiment.scope: freshAllocation app calls inside substitute only

classification_rule.left_hot_right_diffuse: top-32 left-child identity coverage >= 80% and right-child coverage < 80% in both cases
classification_rule.left_diffuse_right_hot: left coverage < 80% and right coverage >= 80% in both cases

post_result_policy.if_left_hot_right_diffuse: prospectively test an exact application-context representation keyed by the hot function child and varying argument
post_result_policy.if_left_diffuse_right_hot: prospectively test the dual exact context keyed by hot argument child and varying function
post_result_policy.if_bilateral_hot: inspect whether a smaller exact pair index is cheaper than current compiled node reuse
post_result_policy.if_bilateral_diffuse: compile obstruction against child-identity-local app reuse and move to traversal/continuation representation
post_result_policy.if_mixed: split the two deep-list frontiers before another representation

claim_boundary: Diagnostic runtime-local child identity concentration only. No application-node reuse across distinct child pairs is authorized.
